driver.name: Sofia Calderini
driver.bio: Swiss-Italian former karting world champion; the coolest head on the grid.
driver.background: From Lugano, in Italian-speaking Switzerland; karting world champion at seventeen, then studied architecture before Saetta called.
driver.personality: Plays chess with her engineers between sessions; her heart rate on the grid is famously low; has out-qualified her teammate Varrone and never mentions it.

style: Original fictional driver in GTA V loading-screen-inspired inked, cel-shaded illustration. No real driver likeness.
motion: 8-second camera settle, staggered team/sponsor reveal, name slide and metadata reveal. Reduced-motion support. Driver is a still illustration, not a skeletal character animation.
scope: One driver concept only; not installed as an automatic race intro pending style approval.
